name: hub-home-fallback-968t22
goal: A signed-in Hub Home performs a full read on the first visible 20-second turn when its connected account sync socket delivers no Home notices.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The 20 s visible timer polls the linked computer but skips the stored Home and project reads until 60 s after the full refresh when the socket stays live without a home notice.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Strengthen the registered live-overview linked Mac fixture (quiet socket, no stored Home upload) and existing visible polling unit case without adding cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Final test-tree checkpoint 3aebf6f8cb: unit run caught the 60000 ms full-read threshold on the 20000 ms visible turn; the original isolated Chromium reproduction caught the missing stored Home request.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Restore the 20-second full-read threshold. The paired checkpoint already includes the browser helper move, so browser tests and fixtures remain identical across the repair.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Committed paired unit runner: red on 3aebf6f8cb and green on 63a1d32c84 with 16 unit checks and the same tracked fixture tree. Chromium red/green on 5c75b7eb73 and db2f5872f5 proved the first-turn failure and repair. All 7 live-overview Chromium cases passed at 933ac68c28 with identical Hub source and tests to 63a1d32c84.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
Check sibling refresh paths for the same quiet live connection blind spot.
